name: Destruction
overview: Scripture reveals that destruction is both a consequence of human pride and a divine judgment executed with righteousness and justice. The Bible warns that the broad path leads many to destruction, contrasting with the narrow gate that leads to life, emphasizing the importance of choosing God's way over self-destruction. God's power to destroy extends beyond the physical body to the soul, underscoring the eternal significance of salvation through Christ, who was given so that believers would not perish but have everlasting life. These truths highlight the serious warnings before destruction and call believers to trust in God's mercy and righteousness.
